#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <queue>

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {}
    
    class FastInput {
    private:
        std::istream& is;
        std::vector<char> buffer;
        int pos, len;
        
    public:
        FastInput(std::istream& in) : is(in), buffer(1 << 15), pos(0), len(0) {}
        
        int nextByte() {
            if (pos >= len) {
                pos = 0;
                is.read(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
                len = is.gcount();
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[pos++]);
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            int c;
            while ((c = nextByte()) <= 32) if (c == -1) return -1;
            int x = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                x = x * 10 + c - '0';
                c = nextByte();
            }
            return x;
        }
    };
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> graph;
    int nodes, edges;
    std::vector<int> potential, level, parentEdge;
    std::vector<int> src, dst, xorEdge, weight;
    std::vector<int> flow;
    
    void setup(int n, int m) {
        graph.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) graph[i].clear();
        potential.assign(n, INF);
        level.assign(n, 0);
        parentEdge.assign(n, 0);
        src.assign(m, 0);
        dst.assign(m, 0);
        xorEdge.assign(m, 0);
        weight.assign(m, 0);
        flow.assign(m * 2, 0);
        edges = 0;
    }
    
    void addConnection(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        int idx = edges++;
        src[idx] = u;
        dst[idx] = v;
        xorEdge[idx] = u ^ v;
        weight[idx] = cost;
        flow[idx * 2] = cap;
        graph[u].push_back(idx * 2);
        graph[v].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    std::vector<int> deque;
    int dqHead, dqTail, dqSize;
    std::vector<bool> inDeque;
    
    void pushToDeque(int node) {
        if (inDeque[node]) return;
        if (dqHead + dqSize == static_cast<int>(deque.size())) {
            if (dqSize * 2 <= static_cast<int>(deque.size())) {
                std::memmove(deque.data(), deque.data() + dqHead, dqSize * sizeof(int));
                dqHead = 0;
            } else {
                std::vector<int> newDeque(deque.size() * 2);
                std::memmove(newDeque.data(), deque.data() + dqHead, dqSize * sizeof(int));
                deque = std::move(newDeque);
                dqHead = 0;
            }
        }
        deque[dqHead + dqSize++] = node;
        inDeque[node] = true;
    }
    
    int popFromDeque() {
        int node = deque[dqHead++];
        dqSize--;
        inDeque[node] = false;
        return node;
    }
    
    bool findShortestPath(int source, int sink) {
        std::fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), INF);
        potential[source] = 0;
        dqHead = dqSize = 0;
        pushToDeque(source);
        
        while (dqSize > 0) {
            int u = popFromDeque();
            int newLevel = level[u] + 1;
            
            for (int edge : graph[u]) {
                if (flow[edge] > 0) {
                    int idx = edge >> 1;
                    int cost = (edge & 1) == 0 ? weight[idx] : -weight[idx];
                    int newPotential = potential[u] + cost;
                    int v = u ^ xorEdge[idx];
                    
                    if (potential[v] > newPotential || 
                        (potential[v] == newPotential && level[v] > newLevel)) {
                        potential[v] = newPotential;
                        level[v] = newLevel;
                        parentEdge[v] = edge;
                        pushToDeque(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return potential[sink] != INF;
    }
    
    void pushFlow(int s, int t) {
        int minFlow = INF;
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= xorEdge[parentEdge[cur] >> 1]) {
            minFlow = std::min(minFlow, flow[parentEdge[cur]]);
        }
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= xorEdge[parentEdge[cur] >> 1]) {
            int e = parentEdge[cur];
            flow[e] -= minFlow;
            flow[e ^ 1] += minFlow;
        }
    }
    
    void pushUnitFlow(int s, int t) {
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= xorEdge[parentEdge[cur] >> 1]) {
            int e = parentEdge[cur];
            flow[e]--;
            flow[e ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int computeMinCost(int source, int sink) {
        while (findShortestPath(source, sink)) {
            pushUnitFlow(source, sink);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < edges; i++) {
            total += weight[i] * flow[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void process() {
        FastInput input(std::cin);
        int n = input.nextInt();
        int m = input.nextInt();
        int k = input.nextInt();
        int c = input.nextInt();
        int d = input.nextInt();
        
        std::vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) special[i] = input.nextInt() - 1;
        
        std::vector<std::vector<int>> adj(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i].clear();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = input.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = input.nextInt() - 1;
            adj[u].push_back(v);
            adj[v].push_back(u);
        }
        
        int T = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
        setup(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                for (int neighbor : adj[i]) {
                    int v = neighbor * T + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        addConnection(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                int v = u + 1;
                addConnection(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            addConnection(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
        }
        
        std::cout << computeMinCost(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << std::endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.process();
    return 0;
}
